name: 49323 · Dorr, MI
findings: ZIP 49323 (Dorr) has 17 nonprofit organizations. 8 of them (47%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 8 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (38% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 49323 (Dorr) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 49323 (Dorr) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 65% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 9 organizations here; 18% of all organizations here have no identified type.
